# Pantry Staples

Things to always have in stock, bought from the Elm Street co-op on Saturdays.

- Bread flour, the 10 kg bag from Hillside Mill
- Dark rye flour for [[Sourdough Starter]]
- Fine sea salt
- Red lentils and chickpeas
- Tinned tomatoes, at least six
- Olive oil from the refill station

The co-op gives a members discount on the first Saturday of the month, so the big flour run happens then.
